primary_estimand: equal-weight per truth-cell difference in binary task success between public history and frozen task-only strong comparator, computed as 1/(4*64) sum_seed sum_truth (Y_public-Y_strong), cluster uncertainty at 64 task+reset IDs
primary_test: two-sided exact 64-cluster sign swap by dynamic programming, EXPLORATORY exchangeability-based inference, NOT randomized causal assignment
secondary_cost_measure: actual per-world private target getter count, 2 public XYZ samples per probe arm, physical neutral t4 probe time, all early stops and wrong confident complete target history
per_task_harm_guard: report both per-task effects and refuse 'universally better' claim if either task point success rate declines
no_p_hacking: Do not combine development32 and test64 clusters in primary claim; no altering eps/margins, seed IDs, matched-pose tolerance, controller, official PPO weights or rule after results
early_refusal: Intention-to-treat: preserve source rows and incomplete injected-fault/probe exposure as censored for condition-specific causal contrast, do NOT delete or replace seeds
action_truth: T2/T3 fully crossed native ACTUAL physically applied versus zero-hold with hidden acknowledgement; known-delivered ZERO t4 neutral probe only for continuing arms
provenance_inference_limitations: simulator source-run authored in same lab not independent replication
64 independent reset clusters not 256 independent robot starts
simulation target hold not actual network packet loss
no VLA task closed-loop or other controller task-competent policy
same first original seed across four truth worlds only near-numerically aligned to precommitted tolerance, not always identical SHA
not a novel learned action adaptation algorithm
